review: 702.39b: the skip claimed no Forge card can have two instances of provoke, but two Hunter Slivers give each Sliver provoke twice. Removed the skip and added scenario 702.39b-1.

scenarios.title: A provoked creature untaps and must block the provoking attacker if able
decisions: A attacks player B with Crested Craghorn.
Provoke triggers; A targets Grizzly Bears and chooses to have it block.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and Grizzly Bears untaps.
B declares blockers: Grizzly Bears blocks Crested Craghorn, as required.
Combat damage is dealt; no spells or abilities are used.

variants.label: bears_must_block
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears untaps and blocks. Crested Craghorn (4/1) deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears and Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to it; both die. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: blocker_unable
variants.delta: B's creature is Ironclaw Orcs (tapped), which cannot block creatures with power 2 or greater.
variants.expected: Ironclaw Orcs untaps but cannot block, so Crested Craghorn is unblocked and deals 4 damage to B (life 16). Both creatures survive.

scenarios.forge_notes: Provoke is a may-trigger; the harness fixes the choice to use it.

scenarios.title: A creature with two instances of provoke triggers twice and can force two blockers

setup.notes: Each Hunter Sliver grants provoke to every Sliver, so each Hunter Sliver has two instances of provoke. The two Grizzly Bears are called Bears 1 and Bears 2.

decisions: A attacks player B with the first Hunter Sliver only.
Each provoke instance triggers; A chooses to use both, targeting Bears 1 with one and Bears 2 with the other.
Both players pass; both triggers resolve.
B declares blockers: every creature required to block the Hunter Sliver does so; no other blocks.
A assigns the Hunter Sliver's 1 combat damage to Bears 1. No spells or abilities are used.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two provoke triggers fire. Bears 1 and Bears 2 both untap and both block the attacking Hunter Sliver. Bears 1 is dealt 1 damage and survives; the attacking Hunter Sliver is dealt 4 damage and dies. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A controls only one Hunter Sliver (the attacker); the second is absent, so the attacker has a single provoke.
variants.expected: One provoke trigger fires, targeting Bears 1. Bears 1 untaps and blocks; Bears 2 stays tapped and does not block. Bears 1 is dealt 1 damage and survives; Hunter Sliver is dealt 2 damage and dies. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge creating one provoke trigger per granted keyword instance.
